book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel tal ol wangwo ha bol engwi

content: Pita honagi ol wangwo ha Yerusalem arihobi di tibi ol tongwo ha
Ena Yudia ganba bina holo holo i aposel hobo ari ha maing pungwo hobi wiyol ta ha maing pir tere wine ongwo ha i pungwi.
Pire mongure Pita mo Yerusalem malgi ongwi. Ongure Yuda ari Yisas pir tongwo hobi wiyol tau gaung bol olo dire, han tere,
Pita yu ditongwi, “Ari wiyol ta gaung bol olekungwo hobi oo kepangwo ala i talongwo one? Talongwo homena ereho nene?”
Ena Pita wa i ongwo talhan u tibi ongwo hangwo meri ha di tibi ole yu ditongwi,
“Na Yopa malgi molere, God ha di te moliba, molga bani ku haniwa. Hanga hamen bani gal apalapo bir weni dungwo meri a bigi holo hol sui sui dire angure mu sire ya na molga bani umua.
Ungure na ala i hanigere, dua hau, onba, hahoba miki weni mongwo haniwa.
Hanigere gala ta, ‘Pitao, ni hau hobi kene ole si no’ di na tomia.
Di na tomba, na ‘God ye, na Yuda ari molia memini pangwo hau hobi gogo ta nekiga irawe’ dia.
Hamen bani gala ta ti hon dire, ‘Talhan hobi God nenana dire ol kuari pai ni tongwo iwe, ari nin mai tenanga paikimua,’ di na tomia.
Talhan hobi gin sui tai dire u tibi ongwo hanigere ere hamen bani omua.
Ongure Sisaria hong yal ta yal su hobi bai nu sungure, gintani u na molga bani pa dimua.
Dungure God Kwiang ‘nomani su su sikirere, ya su hobi kina ereho po,’ di na tomia. Di na tongwo Sisaria nala di ogere, gamna hobo i ana hol pai muru hol pai taniga u na hongure aule ire oiwa.
Pi malgi pa digere yal Konilias ku hangwo meri boling kule yu di na tomia, Ensel ta oo ala ya ure yu di na tomia, yal tau bai nu si Yopa olingere, Saimon Pita aule ire unamia.
Urere ha di ni tenangwo pire ni gaminahobi kina sigare kule u wai nanua.
Ena na Sisaria pire ha kebering hole di te molgere, God Kwiang ya ime ure nan yona wu bungwo mere irai yalhobi ere yu yong wu bimua.
Wu bungure pi tege eminga yal Yisas homa, ‘Yon nir wo bil ni tomba, God nin Kwiang ni tenangure inanua,’ dungwo irai hon nomani si piriwa.

Homa na Yulang Hong Yisas Kraist pir tegere, God nin Kwiang na tongwo mere irai omaga tomia na God manaa di teralo? Yal digan molia ta diteralga paikimua,’ dungure yalhobi pirere homa ha di mere si tongwo i pisole,
God maa e tere yu dungwi, “God aki di tongure ari wiyol tau tal nigi dongwo ol wangwo pisole, nomani si kulu sire, sigare kule u wai ongwo pamua,” dungwi.
Antiok arihobi ure honagi ongwo ha

Ena homa Stiben gongwo gin i, i kura bolimbani olungure, ari God pir tongwo hobi te u susu pire, tau Pinisia ke pangure, tau Saipras ke pangure, tau Antiok ke pai mongwi. Molere Yuda ari tani Yisas ol wai ol na tongwo ha maing boling kul pire pire mongwi.
Momba, mongwo sina i tau Saipras yal tau ire, Sairini yal tau ire dire, Antiok malgi pire wiyol tau hana ya mongwo hobi Yulang Hong Yisas ol wai ol na tongwo ha maing di tibi ol tongwi.
Dite wangwo gin iwe, singaba Yisas yulang tongure ire ware ditomia, ari miki weni Yisas pir tere wine ongwi.
Ena Yerusalem ari ha maing a i wangwo hobi tal ongwo ha i pirere, yal Banabas bai nu si Antiok malgi olungwi.
Olimia pire hangure, God yalhobi tal wai ol tomia pi hanere, gun e tongwi. Tere, “Yulang Hong Yisas ha maing a i si monga meri molo” ditongwi.
Ena yal Banabas iwe, amane dime di mongure God nin Kwiang yong wu bungure nimni mole ha maing ogolo weni yol e pir tongwi. Pir tongure ari miki weni ure Yulang Hong Yisas kebering ala i bengwi.
Bengure Banabas Sol harala dire Tasas malgi ongwi.

Pire Sol mongure aule ire Antiok ungwi. Ure yasuri malgi mole ha maing ari tabin hobi ha nir si te mongwo mongwo, me erin ta wai sungwi. Wai sungure Antiok malgi Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi para i mu dire haang Kristen engwi.
Ena habang gin i God hana togu yal tau Yerusalem aidolere, Antiok malgi ongwi.

Ongwo hobi yal ta Agabas ha diterala dire airungure God Kwiang yong wu bungure awa ha dire “Ganba uling holo holi i para weni menan bir u tibi namua,” ditongwi. Ditongwo meri yal bir Klodias kene ongwo haung u tibi ongwi.

Awa ha i pirere, Antiok Yisas pir tongwo ari hobi moni iku bolere, “Yudia probins ari ha maing pungwo hobi tomingere homena bring si nere monamua” dire moni imu dire, “Ha maing oo kene ongwo yal hobi tenana po” dire, moni Banabas Sol kina tongwi.
Tongure yasuri ire Yudia pire ari ha maing pungwo hobi ebir si tongwi.
